_about: Monster species (SPEC.md › Attacks and spells, Named Legendaries, Art direction). The map's regions.json names species by these ids in each region's monsterTable / bossId / raidBossId / finalBossId; packages/shared/encounters/monsters.js rolls living monsters from them at RUN_START. role: common | boss | raid | final | blocker. healthMult scales monsters.healthCommon (healthBoss / healthRaid / healthFinal for the big ones) and then (1 + monsters.tierScale × (difficulty tier − 1)). stats use the character scale (1..10, 3 neutral). items are ids from data/items36.json: the weapons the monster fights with, staked from its own Health. loot: gold [min, max] (× tier), rarity weights for the item drop, egg chance 0..1, and dropChance (chance an item drops at all). sprite/token are manifest keys. Bosses carry a moods table for the Boss Wheel; special names a behaviour the fight module switches on: mindlink (shares Health with linkedTo and may control the player's active pet for one attack), litter (five parts, each hurt only by its own game family), hightable (every player at the table stakes each round), passive (never attacks; a blocker).

species.name: Drunk Croupier Revenant
species.flavour: Still dealing. Still drinking. Still dead. The first thing every run meets, swaying under the one lit sign.

species.name: Croupier Revenant
species.flavour: Sober, which is worse. Its gloves are stitched to its hands and the house edge is stitched to its smile.

species.name: Card Shark
species.flavour: A literal shark in a waistcoat. It has never lost a hand it dealt itself and does not intend to start with yours.

species.name: Slot Golem
species.flavour: A reliquary on legs, lit from inside by whatever is left of the saints. Pull the arm and pray.

species.name: Roulette Wraith
species.flavour: A breaking wheel with a face in the hub. It spins when it screams and it screams when it spins.

species.name: Loan-Shark Eel
species.flavour: Slides out from under the pier with a ledger in its teeth. Interest is compounding while you read this.

species.name: Drowned Dealer
species.flavour: Went into the black water with the night's take and came back without it. It wants a word about the shortfall.

species.name: Barnacle Bouncer
species.flavour: Door staff for a door that sank years ago. Still checks names. Yours is not on the list.

species.name: Fog Lamplighter
species.flavour: Lights the lanterns that lead you off the pier. The fog is its, and so is everyone in it.

species.name: Gallows Spirit
species.flavour: Hangs from the dice-rope and deals from the drop. Every card it turns is the one it was holding when it fell.

species.name: Hanged-Dice Wraith
species.flavour: The knucklebones on the ropes are its teeth. It rattles them when the wind is right and when it is not.

species.name: Dice-Rope Hangman
species.flavour: Ties the knots. Measures the drop by the stake. Has never once been wrong about a weight.

species.name: Blackwood Owl
species.flavour: Watches every hand in the forest and remembers all of them. Its eyes are two face-down cards.

species.name: Salamander Dealer
species.flavour: Deals from a shoe of molten chips with bare hands. The burns are the tell: it has none.

species.name: Molten Chip Golem
species.flavour: A stack of chips that never cooled. Every one of them was somebody's last.

species.name: Forge Imp
species.flavour: Stokes the pit and steals the ash. Laughs at the exact pitch of a fuse burning down.

species.name: Ash Croupier
species.flavour: What is left of a dealer after the furnace door opened on them. Holds its shape by habit alone.

species.name: Gilded High-Roller Angel
species.flavour: Comped forever. Its wings are gold leaf over bone and it tips in other people's Health.

species.name: The Grey
species.flavour: Small, grey, large-eyed, and never alone: it mind-links with another monster on the map and shares its Health, and on its turn it can take your active pet for one attack.

species.name: Gold-Leaf Knight
species.flavour: Armour of pressed gold over a body of pressed debt. Guards the lifts to the high floors.

species.name: Cloud Usher
species.flavour: Shows you to your seat. The seat is the edge of the tower and the view is the drop.

species.name: Lady Neon, the Last Lit Sign

moods.name: Flickering
moods.text: Half her tubes are out. Half is still plenty.

moods.name: Blazing
moods.text: Every tube lit. The street is pink and so are you.

moods.name: Generous
moods.text: Tonight the sign pays out. Tonight only.

moods.name: Shorting Out
moods.text: Sparks and a hum. She can barely hold her shape.

species.flavour: The one sign still burning on the Strip, and the thing that lives inside it. She has watched every run begin.

species.name: The Loan Shark

moods.name: Collecting
moods.text: Business as usual. The ledger is open.

moods.name: Blood Frenzy
moods.text: Someone bled in the water. It was probably you.

moods.name: Fat on Interest
moods.text: Slow, heavy, and carrying everyone's debt in its belly.

moods.name: Beached
moods.text: The tide went out on it. It is furious about that.

species.flavour: The loan shark is a shark. Twenty feet of grey muscle in a pinstripe, and every Blood Pact on the pier is signed in its blood.

species.name: The Gallowmother

moods.name: Mourning
moods.text: A quiet fight under the ropes.

moods.name: Harvest Night
moods.text: The ropes are full and she wants one more.

moods.name: Rooted
moods.text: Grown into the gallows tree. Hard to kill, slow to swing.

moods.name: Brittle
moods.text: Dry wood. Dry rope. One good pull.

species.flavour: The tree the whole forest grew from, and the hangwoman who planted it. Every die on every rope was a stake she collected.

species.name: The Furnace Dealer

moods.name: Banked Coals
moods.text: Low heat. It is saving itself.

moods.name: White Hot
moods.text: The door is open and the room is the furnace.

moods.name: Slagged
moods.text: Crusted in cooled chips. A wall that deals.

moods.name: Guttering
moods.text: Running out of fuel. Running out of patience.

species.flavour: The Boss Gate is a furnace door and this is what opens it from the inside. It deals in molten chips and takes its cut in skin.

species.name: The Comp, Archangel of the House

moods.name: Gracious
moods.text: It smiles the whole time. That is the worst part.

moods.name: Wrath of the House
moods.text: Cold gold light and no mercy in it.

moods.name: Gilded
moods.text: Armoured in comps. Heavy with everything it never paid out.

moods.name: Moulting
moods.text: Gold leaf coming off in sheets. Underneath is just bone.

species.flavour: The highest roller in the highest room. Its halo is a roulette wheel and its wings are the ledgers of everyone it ever comped.

species.name: The Litter

moods.name: Hungry
moods.text: Five cats, one dirge, no dinner.

moods.name: Feral
moods.text: Something set them off. Claws out.

moods.name: Sleepy
moods.text: Curled in the gallows roots. Wake them gently or not at all.

species.flavour: Five cats in a circus of their own making. Each one is killed only by its own family of game, and the whole litter shares one purse. Needs monsters.raidMinPlayers on the tile; the reward is split.

species.name: The High Table

moods.name: Dealing
moods.text: Seats for everyone. The blinds are Health.

moods.name: All In
moods.text: The table has pushed its whole stack to the middle.

moods.name: Stacked
moods.text: Chips to the ceiling. It will take a while.

species.flavour: A card table that seats the dead rich of the Citadel. Every player at it stakes every round. Needs monsters.raidMinPlayers on the tile; the reward is split.

species.name: The Dealer

moods.name: Patient
moods.text: It has all night. It has had every night.

moods.name: The House Always
moods.text: No face, no tells, no mercy.

moods.name: Throned
moods.text: Seated. Unmoving. The chair is part of it.

moods.name: Tired of Winning
moods.text: It almost wants to lose. Almost.

species.flavour: A faceless Dealer on a throne that is a dealer's chair. The House is a dead god and this is the hand that still deals for it.

species.name: Dungheap
species.flavour: A destructible heap that blocks the hex. Break it and it drops Gold; nobody asks where the Gold was.
